h1: The 6 Best Chair Mats of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: six chair mats for carpet and hard floors, compared on material, thickness, pile height rating and size for office chairs.
summary: The Floortex Ultimat Polycarbonate is our best overall chair mat for carpet. The Marvelux suits thick pile carpet, the MuArts handles the heaviest loads, the Lorell works on any floor, and the Kuyal is the pick for hard floors on a budget.
intro: The most common chair mat mistake is buying one for the wrong floor. A mat with studs on the bottom is meant for carpet and will scratch hardwood, while a smooth mat with a slide-resistant coating belongs on hard floors and will creep on carpet.

We reviewed eight mats and ranked six on the spec sheet: material, thickness, carpet pile rating, weight rating, size and underside grip. Match the mat to the floor first, then to the size of your chair roll.

products.name: Floortex Ultimat Polycarbonate Chair Mat for Carpet
products.verdict: A 48 by 60 inch polycarbonate mat with a gripper back for carpet.
products.description:
The Floortex Ultimat gives you a big 48 by 60 inch sheet of polycarbonate that grips the carpet from below and handles pile up to half an inch. Fire resistance and a GREENGUARD badge round out the listing.

It ranks first because the size, the certification and the grip are all strong at once. The Marvelux below handles thicker carpet but this one is better for most offices.

Buy it if you have standard office carpet. The caveat is that it is in the $100 to $200 tier, pricier than vinyl.
products.idealFor: Office carpet up to 1/2 inch pile.

products.name: Marvelux Heavy Duty Polycarbonate Mat for High Pile Carpets
products.verdict: Rated for carpet up to 3/4 inch, with a studded underside.
products.description:
The Marvelux is the same 48 by 60 inch footprint in a slightly thicker polycarbonate, built to sit on plush carpet as deep as three quarters of an inch, with studs below and light texture above.

It ranks second because it covers thicker carpet than the Floortex, though it does not list the GREENGUARD certification. You gain pile range.

Choose it for plush carpet. The caveat is that the studs are carpet only.
products.skipIf: You have low pile or hard floors.

products.name: MuArts Crystal Clear Heavy Duty Chair Mat
products.verdict: A 5mm rigid mat rated for 1,400 lbs, the highest in this ranking.
products.description:
The MuArts Crystal Clear is a rigid 5mm sheet, 54 inches across but only 32 deep, carrying the top weight figure here at 1,400 lbs. It lies flat on carpet or hard floor and comes with a one-year warranty.

It ranks third because the 54 by 32 inch shape is wide but shallow, so the chair has less room to roll back. You get dual-floor use and a high rating.

Pick it for heavier chairs. The caveat is that shallow depth limits movement.

products.name: HON/OFM Essentials Chair Mat for Low Pile Carpet
products.verdict: A ramped-edge vinyl mat for low pile carpet in the $25 to $50 tier.
products.description:
HON/OFM Essentials is vinyl, 36 inches wide and 48 deep, and suited to thin carpet (a quarter inch of pile at most). Its lip reaches out for the chair, the edges slope gently, and cleats on the back keep it planted.

It ranks fourth because vinyl is less rigid than polycarbonate. In return it costs far less and the ramped edge eases chair entry.

Pick it for a budget carpet setup. The caveat is the 1/4 inch pile limit.

products.name: Lorell Tempered Glass Chairmat Multi-Surface
products.verdict: A 0.25 inch tempered glass mat rated for carpet, hard floor and marble.
products.description:
The Lorell is a quarter inch of tempered glass, the thickest sheet in this ranking, measuring 46 by 36 inches. It is rated for 1,000 lbs, claims suitability on carpet, hard floor and marble, resists scratches, and carries a five-year warranty.

It ranks fifth because the 36 inch depth is short and glass is heavy to handle. You gain the longest warranty.

Choose it for a stylish multi-floor desk. The caveat is weight and shallow depth.

products.name: Kuyal Clear Chair Mat for Hard Floors
products.verdict: A 36 by 48 inch PVC mat with an anti-slide coating for hard floors only.
products.description:
The Kuyal is a 2mm PVC sheet, 36 by 48 inches, with a non-slip coating underneath that makes sense only on hard floors. The listing calls it odorless and BPA-free, with no lead or cadmium.

It ranks last because it cannot be used on carpet and is thinner than the rigid options. It is the simple fix for hardwood.

Pick it for wood or tile floors. The caveat is carpet will make it slide.

whatMatters.detail: Mats are built for carpet or hard floor, and the wrong one slips or marks the surface. Studs and cleats grip carpet, while smooth coatings suit hard floors. Check the listing for the stated floor type.
Carpet pile is the length of the fibres, and a mat rated for low pile will buckle on plush carpet. The ratings here run from 1/4 to 3/4 inch. Look for the number in the title.
Polycarbonate is rigid and clear, vinyl is flexible and cheap, and glass is heavy and stylish. Rigid mats keep their shape under wheels. Check the material in the first line.
A mat should let the chair roll back without leaving the edge. Measure the area you roll through and add margin. Compare depth as well as width.
Ratings range from 1,000 to 1,400 lbs here. They matter for heavier chairs and users. Look for the figure in the specs.

faq.q: Can I use a carpet mat on hardwood?
faq.a: No. Studs and cleats can scratch hard floors. Choose a hard floor mat instead.
Ignoring pile height. A mat rated for low pile will lift on plush carpet.

faq.q: Is glass worth it over polycarbonate?
faq.a: Only for looks and warranty. Polycarbonate is lighter and easier to move.

faq.q: How big should my mat be?
faq.a: Large enough for your full roll, with the chair staying on the mat when you lean back.
Wipe with a damp cloth. Avoid harsh chemicals that cloud plastic.

faq.q: Will a mat flatten curled corners?
faq.a: Rigid mats lie flat. Thin vinyl may curl, so give it time.

finalTake: The Floortex Ultimat is the chair mat most carpeted offices should buy. Choose the Marvelux for thick carpet, the MuArts for heavy chairs, the Lorell for any floor, and the Kuyal for hard floors. Match floor and pile first.
